headline: Report Finds Türkiye Could Electrify 85% of Energy Consumption
summary: A report published by an industry think tank indicated that electricity could supply 85% of Türkiye's final energy consumption using current technologies.
why: Long-term energy transition studies guide infrastructure investment priorities and renewable energy deployment targets for utility providers.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Broad electrification targets signal long-term capital expenditure growth for power grid infrastructure and renewable generation assets.
